message.content: Hey. I need to send a quick note to the supplier, Ferrán, about the tomato order. He’s probably at the market right now, so keep it brief. Tell him the last batch was too watery for the sofrito and I need the dry ones from the interior for Monday. Ask if he has stock.

content.text:
Here is a draft for Ferrán:

"Hola Ferrán, hope the market is treating you well. Quick question on the tomato delivery for Monday: the last batch was a bit too wet for my sofrito. Do you have any dry, meaty tomatoes from the interior available? I need something with more substance this time. Let me know. Thanks, Mateo."

message.content: That looks good. Send it. Now, help me with the weekly shop list. I’m trying to cut down on waste. Check my inventory log from yesterday and tell me what I’m missing for the standard menu.

content.text:
